### Proclaimed by the Prophets
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/proclaimed-by-the-prophets
Passage: Jeremiah 23:5-6
Points:
- Old Testament prophets consistently proclaimed the good news of the coming Mediator.
- Jeremiah foretells a Davidic King equipped to conquer the spiritual enemies of God's people.
- The name "The Lord is our righteousness" explains how God reconciles sinners without compromising His justice.
- Christ fulfills this promise through His sacrificial atonement, satisfying God's justice on our behalf.
- Believers must evaluate all claims of divine revelation against the unchanging standard of Scripture.
